# pq-hash kernel measurements (generated by table.mjs from results/*.json)

libauth 3.1.0-next.8, BCH_2026 instruction set. Op-cost per call: mean over random trials (min–max). "std" uses 192 per hash digest iteration, "cons" 64. "code" = measured bytecode bytes (+ function bodies defined in the prologue). "real VM" = the case also passed the real BCH 2026 VM (standard and consensus) as a P2SH32 spend padded to cover its op-cost; "over" = the padded spend would exceed one standard input (10,000 B), measured on the loosened VM only.
